values.value: Finds: SBQQ__ConfigurationAttribute__c records where SBQQ__Required__c = true but SBQQ__DefaultField__c is null. Why it matters: Reps hit a required field with no prefill — they must guess or look up the value, which slows quote velocity and increases data-entry error rates. Reduces the field's intended automation value. Suppress a finding: when the field is genuinely customer-specific and no sensible default exists (legal entity name, contract reference number). Disable the detector: only if your config attributes are intentionally all manual. Most orgs should leave this on.
